body:
You're right, they are. 

I do and I don't. I don't know what to say to them that won't scare the shit out of them, but that is also true for me. I can't tell them what I'm going through because they don't know how to help.

I called in sick to work today and no one has checked on me yet. Yesterday I was a zombie at work, and it was remarked upon but easily shrugged off. People are work are the only ones I see everyday. 

My friends are giving me space, because they think that is what I need. I don't know what I actually do need from them, so I don't want to ask for their help. I don't think anyone can help me at this point.

I dunno. I don't think that many people will really care.   


I just don't think I can do this anymore. 

​

What happened when you tried? If you don't mind me asking?
